Bombtech Golf Review: Great Value From An Unexpected Place · Practical-Golf.com
s: If I told you that someone was going to start a golf club company in Vermont and was planning to sell directly to golfers over the Internet, you would probably say that they were doomed to fail. I would likely agree with you knowing what I do about the golf equipment industry. Interestingly enough, this company does exist and they have been able to succeed. Their name is BombTech Golf and I recently got a chance to try out some of their clubs.
